## What this does

Plumbing, not part of the method itself. `sort30` sorts the big arrays of
(site, species, time) or (neighbour, target, weight) triples built by
[`make_rec30`](rec30.qmd), so that records sharing the same first field(s)
end up next to each other and can be processed group by group.
`sort_real` sorts a plain array of numbers — used, for example, to find
the percentile of estimated recording effort across all sites at the end
of a `frescalo` run.

### `sort30`

```{.rust filename="src/lib.rs" tangle="lib__sort30"}
pub fn sort30(dict: &mut [Rec30], n: usize) {
    dict[1..=n].sort_unstable();
}
```

### `sort_real`

```{.rust filename="src/lib.rs" tangle="lib__sort_real"}
pub fn sort_real(dict: &mut [f32], n: usize) {
    dict[1..=n].sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
}
```
